pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Maryland GPA

officialLinks.label: Undergraduate GPA calculation and grade points

helpIntro: UMD uses a 4.0 scale for undergraduate GPA. Enter UMD credits and final grades; A+/A=4.0 through D-=0.7, while F/XF=0.
helpNote: For current/post-Fall-2012 undergraduate grading. P, S, I, W and NGR are excluded. Transfer grades do not enter the UMD cumulative GPA. Repeat Impact is unavailable because early-course repeat treatment can depend on the New Student Provision.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 quality points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9. Together, 21.9 ÷ 6 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.F: F counts in GPA at 0.0 quality points.
gradeExplanations.XF: XF counts in GPA at 0.0 quality points.
gradeExplanations.P: P is excluded from GPA; under Pass/Fail, failing work remains a letter D+/D/D-/F as applicable.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.NGR: No Grade Reported is excluded until a grade is recorded.

specialTypes.name: UMD course, current grading
specialTypes.note: Use for standard UMD College Park undergraduate courses under the Fall 2012+ plus/minus scale.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Accepted transfer grades do not enter the UMD cumulative GPA.

specialTypes.name: UMD course before Fall 2012
specialTypes.note: Historical UMD grading used different plus/minus quality points. Check the transcript/policy period.

specialTypes.name: Course repeat / New Student Provision
specialTypes.note: UMD normally counts graded attempts, but qualifying early repeats can use the New Student Provision. Confirm eligibility before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is unavailable because UMD repeat treatment depends on timing and eligibility. Use the manual-review course type for a repeated course when the New Student Provision may apply.
